title: So, you didn't get funded. Now What?

ms.promise:
・Ask the Cardano Foundation and/or Catalyst for the contacts of projects that didn't get funded, or reach out through the Fund11 page. Further information for GDPR compliance purposes:
・The list of projects which have not been funded are public, and there shouldn't be any barrier to sharing them
・We are able to contact all the project initiators through PMs on the ideascale platform
・We'd appreciate it if the Catalyst team could send out a mass mailer asking people to opt-in so we could do this most efficiently, but understand if that's not an option. We'll work within the limits of what's possible.
・Talk to as many people as we can. Find out where not getting funded left them emotionally, whether they are continuing with their project, whether they will resubmit for Fund 12, and if they know what they need to do to increase their chances
・Produce a report on the most common answers by type of project and geography, highlight potential areas of improvement and risk for the ecosystem and opportunities to make the experience better for people
ms.criteria: ・A report on the status of those projects while respecting the privacy of the participants, and identifying the best options to keep those projects alive and funded between now and the next rounds.

ms.promise:
・Lowest-cost ways to get the project rolling (or keep it rolling), especially in a high-cost country like Switzerland.
・Areas of business or development that are riskier from a legal and compliance, and ways to defer or avoid them (at least temporarily) without creating more problems.
・Alternative sources of funding, their upsides and downsides, and longer-term fundraising strategies.
・Webinars, in-person events, digital campaigns, and other forms of engagement.
ms.criteria: ・At least two webinars addressing the top areas of concern or opportunity identified in the initial outreach to the community.
